notes: §32 music adapter slice: transport is forwarded only on a human press (core pass-through). Pandora has no previous-track - the tuner's Replay stands in. Ad-break signal = the tuner's own 'Why ads?' affordance plus a second concurrent sign (visible ad video, or skip disabled), sustained 500 ms on a 250 ms tick; the tuner's own track title reading 'Advertisement' (mini_track_title) is a sign twice over on its own - it flips the moment the ad's audio starts, seconds before the Why-ads affordance and the ad video appear (the ad was audible ~3 s, 2026-09-14) The rewarded video after 'Get Skips' replaces the tuner bar entirely (read live 2026-09-14: no tuner, no Why-ads, a 768x432 <video> from pandora.com/util/mediaserverPublicRedirect under a 768x432 IMA iframe goog_*): a visible IMA ad frame, and a visible video 300px or wider - Pandora's music has none - are each a sign twice over. (was 1 s on 500 ms; with core's window shortened by adSignalSustainedMs the intermission lands about a second after the ad starts, not three - 2026-09-14). 2026-09-15, mute fast / cover slow: the page-side sustain is gone (adSignalSustainedMs with it) - the first concurrent sign is reported at once and core mutes on it, the cover waits core's own window; a MutationObserver on the document runs the tick on the mutation itself, the 250 ms timer stands in. The rewarded video ('Get My Skips': Pandora's own #adContainer .Video__Container modal with its playing video, seen in the Veil reports 2026-09-12) is a sign on its own, twice over - the offer to watch it is the page's to show; the ad it plays is intermissioned (2026-09-14). Pandora is adapter-only by design (§32); Premium accounts never trip the signal. Cross-service lookup (musicLookup) drives the page's own search and menu by their English labels (Actions available, Start Station from Song): English only for now.
